requirements.summary: List sorted by last name, 5 per page; pager reaches every offender; count matches what is reachable
Search by first/last name or national ID — substring, case-insensitive
Create offender with required/unique/past-date/enum validation; invalid input rejected with clear message
Edit persists exactly the form values; untouched fields keep their values
Delete after confirmation removes offender and all trail data
Dates shown as DD/MM/YYYY and equal to the stored value
Trail ordered oldest → newest in table and on the map line
Clicking a map point shows its timestamp, speed, battery, signal
Latest reading = most recent point; Last seen = its timestamp
Add location with coordinate / speed / battery / signal validation
Top-bar totals are live and accurate after every create/delete
GET /api/offenders paging contract; metadata consistent with data
404 for unknown resources; 201 on create; 204 on delete
POST/PUT enforce UI validation rules; 400 with error description
Stats totals consistent with stored data at all times
